speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: If there is no suitable person who can apply to be their deputy, a professional deputy can apply to the Courts to act on their behalf.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: We encourage caregivers of persons with disabilities to plan ahead and approach SG Enable and the Special Needs Trust Company early for future care planning support for their loved ones, including deputyship matters, financial planning, respite care and peer support.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: Will the Ministry consider developing and implementing an early identification and support programme for such caregivers that is on a multi-agency basis, beyond MSF and perhaps with the Ministry of Health (MOH), Agency for Integrated Care (AIC), with the Active Ageing Centres (AACs) on the ground, and in fact, including other stakeholders like the Law Society and doctors?

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: I say lawyers and doctors, because they may have to interface with such families in the course of their related work.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: Rather than to leave it to the families to seek help when they have illness like dementia, because at that point in time, they may not have sufficient extended family support.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
text: So, I would urge the Government to consider looking into this.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: In the reply by MOH to hon Member Mr Gan Thiam Poh's Parliamentary Question in May 2022, MOH has made clear that the outreach by AIC on LPA awareness, on things such as future care planning, is already ongoing.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: AIC, together with the community partners on the ground, is already doing a lot of work to make sure that the drawing up of an LPA and other related end-of-life or future care planning instruments are as well-known or as propagated as possible.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: There has been some momentum, from what I know, there has been quite a bit of community ground-up efforts as well to encourage the drawing up of LPAs as well as advanced care plans.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: But we note that there is always room and capacity to do more.
